# Glideleaf

> Open-source Windows-to-iPad mouse and keyboard sharing over Bluetooth LE HID.

Glideleaf forwards input through a dedicated USB Bluetooth adapter bound to
WinUSB. An iPad-side app and a cloud relay are not required. It does not provide
shared clipboard, file drag-and-drop, screen mirroring or no-dongle operation.

Status: alpha source preview. Automated virtual BLE and Windows UI checks are
separate from physical-device qualification, which remains pending in this fork.
Nine GUI languages are implemented. CLI and installer translation are not claimed.

Glideleaf is an independent derivative of fuba/winuc. Original MIT copyright and
Git history are preserved. It is not an official Apple or fuba product.
